derivation: A uniform 2 kg box has COM Izz=0.00833333 kg*m^2.
Shift the reference by [0.0, 0.02, 0.0] m.
The parallel-axis contribution to Izz is 0.00080000 kg*m^2.
Total Izz is 0.00913333; requested z acceleration is 3 rad/s^2.
Ignoring other dynamics, required z torque is 0.02740000 Nm.
notes: This acceleration-only torque excludes gravity, Coriolis terms, friction and transmission effects.
An inertia tensor attached to the wrong origin can make a controller consistently wrong even when total mass is correct.
